english: Choose the language of these pages
Change it at any time with the flag at the top. The Pi's own messages stay in English.
translation: Unaweza kuibadilisha wakati wowote kwa bendera iliyo juu. Ujumbe wa Pi yenyewe unabaki kwa Kiingereza.

english: The web console is off. To turn it on, over SSH on the Pi:
translation: Konsoli ya wavuti imezimwa. Ili kuiwasha, kupitia SSH kwenye Pi:

english: Or in the menu: 7 Options → 4 Web console. The wall.
translation: Au kwenye menyu: 7 Options → 4 Web console. Ukuta.

english: Or sign in with your phone
QR code to scan with a phone signed in to the console
translation: Msimbo wa QR wa kuchanganua kwa simu iliyoingia kwenye konsoli

english: No console password yet. Choose one over SSH on the Pi:
translation: Bado hakuna nenosiri la konsoli. Chagua nenosiri kupitia SSH kwenye Pi:

english: Sign in a phone without typing
translation: Ingia kwa simu bila kuandika chochote

english: On a computer already signed in: System → Signed in → Pair a phone, or over SSH:
translation: Kwenye kompyuta iliyokwisha kuingia: Mfumo → Vifaa vilivyoingia → Oanisha simu, au kupitia SSH:

english: Then scan the QR code with the phone's camera. It works once, within five minutes; the phone then stays signed in as long as it opens the console once a month. No password is needed for it.
translation: Kisha changanua msimbo wa QR kwa kamera ya simu. Unafanya kazi mara moja tu, ndani ya dakika tano; baada ya hapo simu inabaki imeingia mradi tu inafungua konsoli mara moja kwa mwezi. Haihitaji nenosiri lolote.

english: That QR code is never shown on this page, on purpose: here it would sign in anyone on your network who scans it. (With phone sign-in on, this page shows another one: it signs this computer in, once a phone already signed in says yes.)
translation: Msimbo huo wa QR hauonyeshwi kamwe kwenye ukurasa huu, kwa makusudi: hapa ungemwingiza mtu yeyote kwenye mtandao wako atakayeuchanganua. (Kuingia kwa simu kukiwa kumewashwa, ukurasa huu unaonyesha msimbo mwingine: unaiwezesha kompyuta hii kuingia, mara simu iliyokwisha kuingia inapokubali.)
Chapisho 2 · Ndege za mizigo na jeti binafsi ↗
Chapisho 4 · Usafiri wa anga wa jumla ↗

english: You were signed out (the session ended, or someone signed everyone out).
translation: Umeondolewa kwenye konsoli (kipindi kimeisha, au mtu fulani amewaondoa wote).

english: The wall cannot write its console folder yet: pairing and changes will fail. Over SSH: sudo systemctl restart zenithboard-flightinfo
translation: Ukuta bado hauwezi kuandika kwenye folda yake ya konsoli: kuoanisha na kufanya mabadiliko kutashindwa. Kupitia SSH: sudo systemctl restart zenithboard-flightinfo

english: This pairing code did not work.
translation: Msimbo huu wa kuoanisha haukufanya kazi.

english: Sign this phone in first; then the computer's request is shown.
translation: Ingia kwa simu hii kwanza; kisha ombi la kompyuta litaonyeshwa.

english: The Pi does not answer. Is the wall running?
translation: Pi haijibu. Je, ukuta unafanya kazi?

english: Scan it with a phone already signed in to the console, check that it shows {code}, and say yes.
translation: Changanua msimbo huu kwa simu iliyokwisha kuingia kwenye konsoli, hakikisha inaonyesha {code}, kisha ukubali.

english: The code is out of date.
This sign-in code is out of date.
translation: Muda wa msimbo huu wa kuingia umekwisha.

english: This computer's request is {state}: it shows a new code.
translation: Hali ya ombi la kompyuta hii ni {state}: inaonyesha msimbo mpya.

english: Too late: the computer shows a new code.
Say yes only if the computer in front of you shows this same code. It is signed in for a week (a day unused); System → Signed in signs it out.
translation: Kubali tu ikiwa kompyuta iliyo mbele yako inaonyesha msimbo huu huu. Itabaki imeingia kwa wiki moja (siku moja isipotumika); Mfumo → Vifaa vilivyoingia huiondoa.

english: It is written everywhere it is stored on this Pi (the wall, and the feeders that can be set from here); the ones that cannot are named in the output. The position is never shown on the wall or in a post.
translation: Mahali pa antena huandikwa kila sehemu panapohifadhiwa kwenye Pi hii (ukutani, na kwenye feeder zinazoweza kurekebishwa kutoka hapa); zile zisizoweza kurekebishwa zinatajwa kwenye matokeo. Mahali hapa hapaonyeshwi kamwe ukutani wala kwenye chapisho.

english: Turning it on runs its author's installer: collectd and rrdtool from apt (signed), its files from GitHub, a few minutes. Turning it off puts back what was there before and keeps its history.
translation: Kuiwasha kunaendesha kisakinishi cha mwandishi wake: collectd na rrdtool kutoka apt (zimesainiwa), faili zake kutoka GitHub, dakika chache. Kuizima kunarudisha kilichokuwepo awali na kunahifadhi historia yake.

english: The decoder restarts with the new gain: a few seconds without aircraft. Go one step at a time, and check again after a day.
translation: Kisimbuzi kinawashwa upya kikiwa na ukuzaji mpya: sekunde chache bila ndege. Nenda hatua moja baada ya nyingine, kisha kagua tena baada ya siku moja.

english: Switching it on starts posting the aircraft worth it to Bluesky, as set in Sharing (place name, radius, rules, gap). Off stops the service; the account stays.
translation: Kuiwasha kunaanza kuchapisha kwenye Bluesky ndege zinazostahili, kama ilivyowekwa kwenye Kushiriki (jina la mahali, nusukipenyo, kanuni, muda kati ya machapisho). Ikizimwa, huduma inasimama; akaunti inabaki.

english: If the Pi freezes completely, its own chip restarts it after about 10 seconds. Off takes the setting away again.
translation: Pi ikikwama kabisa, chipu yake yenyewe inaiwasha upya baada ya takriban sekunde 10. Ikizimwa, mpangilio huo unaondolewa tena.

english: Seconds. The wall restarts, so this page reconnects by itself. The feeders are left as they are.
translation: Sekunde chache. Ukuta unawashwa upya, kwa hiyo ukurasa huu unajiunganisha tena wenyewe. Feeder zinaachwa kama zilivyo.

english: ZenithBoard, the decoder and every feeder, one after the other: several minutes. The wall restarts during it; this page follows. A new GitHub signing key is never accepted from here: the update says so, and it is answered over SSH.
translation: ZenithBoard, kisimbuzi na kila feeder, moja baada ya nyingine: dakika kadhaa. Ukuta unawashwa upya wakati huo; ukurasa huu unafuata. Ufunguo mpya wa kusaini wa GitHub haukubaliwi kamwe kutoka hapa: sasisho linasema hivyo, na linajibiwa kupitia SSH.

english: Sign computers in with a phone

When on, a computer's sign-in page shows a QR code. A phone already signed in scans it, sees the computer, its address and a four-digit code, and says yes: the computer is signed in, no password. Off again: computers use the password.
translation: Kipengele hiki kikiwashwa, ukurasa wa kuingia wa kompyuta unaonyesha msimbo wa QR. Simu iliyokwisha kuingia inauchanganua, inaona kompyuta, anwani yake na msimbo wa tarakimu nne, kisha inakubali: kompyuta inaingia, bila nenosiri. Kikizimwa tena: kompyuta zinatumia nenosiri.
Ungependa kufuta nakala rudufu ya konsoli?

english: Only the copy kept here for download: the files you already downloaded, and the Pi itself, are not touched.
translation: Ni nakala iliyohifadhiwa hapa kwa ajili ya kupakuliwa pekee: faili ulizokwisha kupakua, na Pi yenyewe, haziguswi.

english: Switching it on installs Tailscale the first time (from its own repository, a few minutes), then prints a sign-in link in this card: open it, sign in to YOUR Tailscale account, approve the Pi. The wall then answers your Tailscale devices too. Off disconnects the Pi from your Tailscale network; it stays installed. The wall restarts either way: this page reconnects by itself.
translation: Kuiwasha kunasakinisha Tailscale mara ya kwanza (kutoka hazina yake yenyewe, dakika chache), kisha kunaonyesha kiungo cha kuingia kwenye kadi hii: kifungue, ingia kwenye akaunti YAKO ya Tailscale, iidhinishe Pi. Baada ya hapo ukuta unajibu pia vifaa vyako vya Tailscale. Ikizimwa, Pi inatenganishwa na mtandao wako wa Tailscale; inabaki imesakinishwa. Ukuta unawashwa upya kwa vyovyote vile: ukurasa huu unajiunganisha tena wenyewe.

english: On: the devices signed in to your Tailscale account can open this console too (encrypted by Tailscale; the password still applies). Off: your home network only. The wall restarts: this page reconnects by itself.
translation: Imewashwa: vifaa vilivyoingia kwenye akaunti yako ya Tailscale vinaweza pia kufungua konsoli hii (imesimbwa kwa njia fiche na Tailscale; nenosiri bado linahitajika). Imezimwa: mtandao wako wa nyumbani pekee. Ukuta unawashwa upya: ukurasa huu unajiunganisha tena wenyewe.

english: Its pages stop answering at once, this one included. Turn it on again over SSH: sudo zenithboard console on
translation: Kurasa zake zinaacha kujibu mara moja, ukiwemo huu. Iwashe tena kupitia SSH: sudo zenithboard console on

english: Queued: {job} runs first, then this. The Pi does one change at a time.
translation: Kwenye foleni: {job} inatangulia, kisha hii. Pi hufanya badiliko moja kwa wakati mmoja.

english: The console's helper has not taken the job. Over SSH: sudo zenithboard console on
translation: Msaidizi wa konsoli hajapokea kazi hii. Kupitia SSH: sudo zenithboard console on

english: {job}: it did not work. See Activity.

translation: Seva ya wavuti ya ramani ya kipokezi

english: What this Pi shows, and what it can show once switched on.
translation: Kile Pi hii inachoonyesha, na kile inachoweza kuonyesha vipengele vikiwashwa.

english: The default of every screen. A tablet that chose its own with its gear keeps it until Reset in its gear panel.
translation: Chaguomsingi la kila skrini. Kompyuta kibao iliyojichagulia mwonekano wake kupitia aikoni ya gia inaubakiza hadi ibonyeze Reset kwenye paneli ya gia.

english: Dot matrix, or the split-flap airport board
translation: Matriki ya nukta, au ubao wa uwanja wa ndege wenye vibao vinavyogeuka

english: Aircraft inside it are on the wall, in {unit}
translation: Ndege zilizo ndani yake huonyeshwa ukutani, kwa {unit}

english: From Planespotters, with their credit; needs internet
translation: Kutoka Planespotters, pamoja na jina la mpiga picha; inahitaji intaneti

english: Where flights come from and go to
translation: Safari za ndege zinatoka wapi na zinaenda wapi

english: The callsign is looked up on adsbdb.com
translation: Ishara ya mwito inatafutwa kwenye adsbdb.com
Hifadhidata ya ndege ya ramani ya kipokezi

english: Registrations and models read on the card (tar1090); nothing downloaded
translation: Usajili na modeli husomwa kwenye kadi (tar1090); hakuna kinachopakuliwa

english: Monthly refresh of the model names
translation: Usasishaji wa kila mwezi wa majina ya modeli

english: A free list from GitHub, once a month
translation: Orodha huria kutoka GitHub, mara moja kwa mwezi

english: The United States adds the optional 978 MHz UAT step (menu 1)
translation: Marekani inaongeza hatua ya hiari ya UAT 978 MHz (menu 1)

english: Decimal degrees, altitude in metres. Written everywhere it is stored; never shown on the wall or in a post.
translation: Nyuzi za desimali, mwinuko kwa mita. Huandikwa kila mahali inapohifadhiwa; haionyeshwi kamwe ukutani wala kwenye chapisho.

english: A sample every 15 minutes, 30 days kept, about 30 KB a day
translation: Sampuli moja kila dakika 15, siku 30 zinahifadhiwa, takriban 30 KB kwa siku

english: Years of the decoder's graphs on port 8542; installed by its author's script
translation: Miaka ya grafu za kisimbuzi kwenye lango 8542; husakinishwa kwa skripti ya mwandishi wake

english: A black page in the wall's colour, its graphs drawn to match; off: graphs1090's own
translation: Ukurasa mweusi kwa rangi ya ukuta, na grafu zilizochorwa kuendana nao; imezimwa: mwonekano asili wa graphs1090

english: Check it first; then one step at a time
translation: Kagua kwanza; kisha hatua moja kwa wakati

english: One measurement every 15 minutes, as a table
translation: Kipimo kimoja kila dakika 15, kwa jedwali
Ishara za mwito na aina zisizojulikana

english: Account @{account}. The account itself is set up over SSH (it asks for an app password): sudo zenithboard social setup
translation: Akaunti @{account}. Akaunti yenyewe inawekwa kupitia SSH (inaomba nenosiri la programu): sudo zenithboard social setup

english: No Bluesky account yet. Set it up over SSH, it asks for an app password: sudo zenithboard social setup
translation: Bado hakuna akaunti ya Bluesky. Iweke kupitia SSH, inaomba nenosiri la programu: sudo zenithboard social setup

english: As set below. Never a distance or a direction.
translation: Kama ilivyowekwa hapa chini. Kamwe hakuna umbali wala mwelekeo.

english: Two or three words, as the posts say it: a town name reads “above” it; empty: no place. Never the receiver's position.
translation: Maneno mawili au matatu, kama machapisho yanavyoyaandika: jina la mji hutanguliwa na “above”; tupu: hakuna mahali. Mahali pa kipokezi hapatajwi kamwe.

english: Kilometres; an aircraft inside it is a candidate. Not the wall's radius.
translation: Kilomita; ndege iliyo ndani yake inaweza kuchapishwa. Si nusukipenyo cha ukuta.

english: Everything: every crossing, the special ones first
translation: Kila kitu: kila ndege inayopita, zile maalum kwanza
Muda wa chini kati ya machapisho
Dakika; 0 = kila ndege inayopita huchapishwa mara moja

english: From GeoNames, made on the Pi (a few minutes); off: the lists shipped with ZenithBoard
translation: Kutoka GeoNames, yanatengenezwa kwenye Pi (dakika chache); imezimwa: orodha zinazokuja na ZenithBoard

english: The wall's own, one of the five, or in turn
translation: Rangi ya ukuta, mojawapo ya zile tano, au kwa zamu

english: Planespotters, at the end of each post
The aircraft posts and the summaries' words; the pictures stay in English
translation: Machapisho ya ndege na maneno ya mihtasari; picha zinabaki kwa Kiingereza

english: One or more; with several, one is drawn at each post
translation: Mtindo mmoja au zaidi; ikichaguliwa kadhaa, mmoja huchaguliwa kwa nasibu kwa kila chapisho

english: At the end of each post, separated by spaces (the # is optional); empty: none
translation: Mwishoni mwa kila chapisho, zikitenganishwa kwa nafasi (# si lazima); tupu: hakuna

english: From the statistics, at their time on the Pi's clock; the posts go in one queue, two minutes apart. Posts: 1 the period, 2 cargo and business jets, 3 military, 4 general aviation.
translation: Kutoka kwenye takwimu, kwa wakati wake kulingana na saa ya Pi; machapisho yanaenda kwenye foleni moja, kwa tofauti ya dakika mbili. Machapisho: 1 kipindi, 2 ndege za mizigo na jeti binafsi, 3 ndege za kijeshi, 4 usafiri wa anga wa jumla.

english: Statistics are off: no summary can be made until they are on (Receiver).
translation: Takwimu zimezimwa: hakuna muhtasari unaoweza kutengenezwa hadi ziwashwe (Kipokezi).

english: Each summary goes once at its time: moved to later today, it goes today; set to a time already past, from the next one. Why one did not go out: sudo zenithboard social summary why
translation: Kila muhtasari huchapishwa mara moja kwa wakati wake: ukisogezwa hadi baadaye leo, huchapishwa leo; ukiwekwa kwa wakati ambao umeshapita, kuanzia unaofuata. Kwa nini muhtasari haukuchapishwa: sudo zenithboard social summary why

english: Posting one now stays in the terminal, where you see it first: sudo zenithboard social summary weekly post
translation: Kuchapisha mmoja sasa kunabaki kwenye terminal, ambapo unauona kwanza: sudo zenithboard social summary weekly post

english: All off by default; each one off again puts back what it found.
translation: Vyote vimezimwa kwa chaguomsingi; kila kimoja kikizimwa tena kinarudisha hali ilivyokuwa awali.

english: The Pi's own chip restarts it after a complete freeze
translation: Chipu ya Pi yenyewe huiwasha upya baada ya kukwama kabisa

english: No router for 6 minutes: the network restarts; 12 minutes: the Pi
translation: Ruta ikikosekana kwa dakika 6: mtandao unawashwa upya; dakika 12: Pi
Kumbukumbu zinazobaki baada ya kuwasha upya

english: Up to 50 MB: what happened just before a freeze
translation: Hadi 50 MB: kilichotokea kabla tu ya kukwama

english: Retry without end after a loss; no radio power saving
translation: Kujaribu tena bila kikomo baada ya muunganisho kupotea; hakuna kuokoa nishati ya redio
Marekebisho ya usalama ya kila siku

english: Debian's security channel only; feeders untouched, no reboot
translation: Chaneli ya usalama ya Debian pekee; feeder hazibadilishwi, hakuna kuwasha upya

english: From GitHub, checked against its signature before anything runs; your settings are never changed by an update.
translation: Kutoka GitHub, yakithibitishwa kwa sahihi yake kabla ya kitu chochote kuendeshwa; mipangilio yako haibadilishwi kamwe na sasisho.

english: ZenithBoard {version} runs here. The release notes:
translation: ZenithBoard {version} inaendeshwa hapa. Maelezo ya toleo:

english: One file with the settings, the features that are on, the statistics, what was posted, graphs1090's history and the kept logs: to keep, or to start a new card where this one stopped.
translation: Faili moja yenye mipangilio, vipengele vilivyowashwa, takwimu, vilivyochapishwa, historia ya graphs1090 na kumbukumbu zilizohifadhiwa: ya kutunza, au ya kuanzisha kadi mpya pale ambapo hii iliishia.

english: Made {when} ({ago}), {size} on the card. One copy is kept here, replaced by the next; its name says the Pi and the date, so downloads sort in time order.
translation: Imetengenezwa {when} ({ago}), {size} kwenye kadi. Nakala moja huhifadhiwa hapa, na kubadilishwa na inayofuata; jina lake linataja Pi na tarehe, kwa hiyo faili zilizopakuliwa hupangika kwa mfuatano wa wakati.

english: In the terminal of the Pi that receives it: sudo zenithboard backup restore FILE (or the menu: 6 Backup → 2 Put a backup back). It shows what the file holds, asks you to type RESTORE, and keeps what it replaces.
translation: Kwenye terminal ya Pi inayoipokea: sudo zenithboard backup restore FAILI (au menyu: 6 Backup → 2 Put a backup back). Inaonyesha yaliyomo kwenye faili, inakuomba uandike RESTORE, na inahifadhi kile inachokibadilisha.

english: Not from this page, on purpose: a restore replaces data and runs installers as root, like the other steps that ask for a typed word.
translation: Si kutoka ukurasa huu, kwa makusudi: urejeshaji unabadilisha data na kuendesha visakinishi kama root, kama hatua nyingine zinazoomba neno liandikwe.

english: This copy leaves the networks' identities out (keys never travel through this page). To move to a new card, make the full one in the terminal: sudo zenithboard backup make.
translation: Nakala hii haijumuishi utambulisho wa mitandao (funguo hazipiti kamwe kwenye ukurasa huu). Ili kuhamia kadi mpya, tengeneza nakala kamili kwenye terminal: sudo zenithboard backup make.

english: Step by step, and why the MAC address does not get in the way:
translation: Hatua kwa hatua, na kwa nini anwani ya MAC haileti tatizo:

english: Wi-Fi networks, fixed addresses and the domain name's key stay in the terminal (sudo zenithboard menu → 3 Connectivity): one mistake there cuts the Pi off the network this page comes through.
translation: Mitandao ya Wi-Fi, anwani za kudumu na ufunguo wa jina la kikoa vinabaki kwenye terminal (sudo zenithboard menu → 3 Connectivity): kosa moja huko linaitenganisha Pi na mtandao ambao ukurasa huu unapitia.

english: On: reachable from anywhere by the devices of your Tailscale account, no port opened.
translation: Imewashwa: inafikiwa kutoka popote na vifaa vya akaunti yako ya Tailscale, bila kufungua lango lolote.

english: Off. The wall, the statistics and graphs1090 from anywhere, with no port opened: your phone or computer joins your own Tailscale network (a free account on tailscale.com, its app on the phone).
translation: Imezimwa. Ukuta, takwimu na graphs1090 kutoka popote, bila kufungua lango lolote: simu au kompyuta yako inajiunga na mtandao wako mwenyewe wa Tailscale (akaunti ya bure kwenye tailscale.com, na programu yake kwenye simu).

english: Off: the Pi leaves your Tailscale network; it stays installed and signed in
translation: Imezimwa: Pi inaondoka kwenye mtandao wako wa Tailscale; inabaki imesakinishwa na imeingia

english: The first time it installs Tailscale (minutes), then its sign-in link appears below: open it, sign in to your account, approve the Pi
translation: Mara ya kwanza inasakinisha Tailscale (dakika kadhaa), kisha kiungo chake cha kuingia kinaonekana hapa chini: kifungue, ingia kwenye akaunti yako, iidhinishe Pi

english: Only your Tailscale devices; its password still applies. Off: home network only
translation: Vifaa vyako vya Tailscale pekee; nenosiri lake bado linahitajika. Imezimwa: mtandao wa nyumbani pekee

english: Its address: {address}. Open these from a device with the Tailscale app on.
translation: Anwani yake: {address}. Fungua viungo hivi kutoka kwenye kifaa chenye programu ya Tailscale ikiwa imewashwa.

english: Removing it completely (sign-out, uninstall) asks for a typed word: in the terminal, sudo zenithboard tailscale remove. Step by step:
translation: Kuiondoa kabisa (kutoka kwenye akaunti, kuifuta kwenye mfumo) kunahitaji neno liandikwe: kwenye terminal, sudo zenithboard tailscale remove. Hatua kwa hatua:

english: The language of these pages, the statistics and graphs1090 for every browser that did not choose its own. The flag at the top chooses for this browser only. What the Pi prints (the terminal, the cards' output) stays in English.
translation: Lugha ya kurasa hizi, ya takwimu na ya graphs1090 kwa kila kivinjari ambacho hakijachagua lugha yake. Bendera iliyo juu inachagua kwa ajili ya kivinjari hiki pekee. Kile ambacho Pi inaandika (terminal, matokeo kwenye kadi) kinabaki kwa Kiingereza.

english: Its own name; a language with no translation yet is not listed
translation: Kwa jina lake lenyewe; lugha ambayo bado haijatafsiriwa haionyeshwi kwenye orodha

english: A word that reads wrong? Every language has its review sheet, the English beside it:
translation: Kuna neno linalosikika vibaya? Kila lugha ina jedwali lake la ukaguzi, Kiingereza kikiwa kando yake:

english: Browsers and phones signed in to this console. Signed in with the password: a week (a day unused). A paired phone: as long as it opens the console once a month.
translation: Vivinjari na simu zilizoingia kwenye konsoli hii. Kilichoingia kwa nenosiri: wiki moja (siku moja kisipotumika). Simu iliyooanishwa: mradi tu inafungua konsoli mara moja kwa mwezi.

english: A computer's sign-in page shows a QR code; a phone signed in here scans it and says yes
translation: Ukurasa wa kuingia wa kompyuta unaonyesha msimbo wa QR; simu iliyoingia hapa inauchanganua na kukubali

english: Only in the terminal, on purpose
Uninstalling, and anything that asks for a typed word
translation: Kuondoa programu, na chochote kinachoomba neno liandikwe

english: Wi-Fi, fixed addresses (they can cut this page off)
translation: Wi-Fi, anwani za kudumu (zinaweza kukata muunganisho wa ukurasa huu)

english: Passwords, tokens and keys: Bluesky, the domain name, this console's own
translation: Manenosiri, tokeni na funguo: Bluesky, jina la kikoa, na la konsoli hii yenyewe

english: Posting to Bluesky, emptying statistics or logs, importing settings, restoring a backup
translation: Kuchapisha kwenye Bluesky, kufuta takwimu au kumbukumbu, kuingiza mipangilio, kurejesha nakala rudufu

english: This page travels unencrypted on your home network (plain HTTP), like the wall. It answers home addresses only.
translation: Ukurasa huu unapita bila usimbaji fiche kwenye mtandao wako wa nyumbani (HTTP ya kawaida), kama ukuta. Unajibu anwani za nyumbani pekee.

english: the flight number when known (FR4512), else the callsign
translation: namba ya safari ikijulikana (FR4512), la sivyo ishara ya wito

english: the country the airline is based in
that country's flag, as an emoji
translation: bendera ya nchi hiyo, kama emoji

english: the country it is registered in
airliner, cargo aircraft, business jet, helicopter…
translation: ndege ya abiria, ndege ya mizigo, jeti binafsi, helikopta…
inapanda, inashuka au iko kwenye mwinuko thabiti

english: why it is posted: A rare visitor.
your place name, as the posts say it
translation: jina la mahali pako, kama machapisho yanavyolitaja

english: The same numbers as a table

A sample every 15 minutes misses an aircraft that crossed in less, so an aircraft count is a floor, never a total. Messages are what the receiver decoded. Everything on this page follows the period chosen at the top. The lists count each aircraft once in the period: airlines by callsign, models from the aircraft database, countries from the aircraft's address. An airline's flag is the country it is based in (cargo and airline lists checked against a published source), else the one its aircraft are registered in. The wall · zenithboard stats prints the same in the terminal. Cities: GeoNames, CC BY 4.0. Flags: country-flag-icons, MIT.
translation: Sampuli moja kila dakika 15 hukosa ndege iliyopita kwa muda mfupi zaidi, kwa hiyo idadi ya ndege ni kiwango cha chini, kamwe si jumla kamili. Ujumbe ni ule ambao kipokezi kilisimbua. Kila kitu kwenye ukurasa huu kinafuata kipindi kilichochaguliwa juu. Orodha zinahesabu kila ndege mara moja katika kipindi: mashirika ya ndege kwa ishara ya mwito, modeli kutoka hifadhidata ya ndege, nchi kutoka anwani ya ndege. Bendera ya shirika la ndege ni ya nchi yalipo makao yake makuu (orodha za ndege za mizigo na za mashirika ya ndege zimelinganishwa na chanzo kilichochapishwa), vinginevyo ni ya nchi ambako ndege zake zimesajiliwa. Ukuta · zenithboard stats huonyesha vivyo hivyo kwenye terminal. Miji: GeoNames, CC BY 4.0. Bendera: country-flag-icons, MIT.
Hakuna ndege iliyosikika katika kipindi hiki.
